headline: paul and pensukesan move into the ARC-3 gold places

sections.text: On the ARC-3 public board, paul rose from 64th to 16th with 40.75, a gain of 5.52 points. pensukesan climbed from 28th to 13th with 42.27, a gain of 5.05 points.
Both teams are now inside the gold places on the public board. Those placings remain provisional until the private board decides the medals.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
